About The Venom Gym Official – Venom Gym, Gym Venom Karachi

The Venom Gym, also known as Venom Gym and Gym Venom, is the official gym of Burns Road, Karachi. Join The Venom Gym Official for strength training, cardio, certified personal trainers, protein and supplements, and gym equipment repair near Fresco Chowk. Hungry Like Venom.

What is The Venom Gym Official?

The Venom Gym Official (also searched as Venom Gym or Gym Venom) is a premium gym on Burns Road, Karachi with strength and cardio equipment, certified personal trainers, a protein and supplements shop, and gym equipment repair service.

Where is The Venom Gym located?

The Venom Gym is at Muhammad bin Qasim Street, Main Fresco Chowk, in front of Molty Foam Main, Burns Road, Karachi.

What are The Venom Gym membership fees?

Gym memberships start from Rs 5,000 per month. The yearly package is Rs 52,000 without a trainer and Rs 105,000 with a trainer.

What are The Venom Gym timings?

Monday to Saturday 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM, Monday to Friday 4:00 PM to 11:00 PM, and Saturday 4:00 PM to 11:30 PM.

Does Venom Gym have personal trainers?

Yes, Venom Gym (Gym Venom) has certified personal trainers you can hire directly on WhatsApp from the Gym Trainer page.

How can I contact The Venom Gym Official?

Call or WhatsApp +92 306 0037330, email thevenomgymoffical@gmail.com, or follow @the_venomgym_official on Instagram.
